name: Atoms, isotopes, mixtures and electronic structure

terms.definition: The smallest part of an element that can exist; a nucleus of protons and neutrons surrounded by electrons.
terms.examiner: Atoms have no overall charge: protons equal electrons.

terms.definition: A substance made of only one type of atom.
terms.examiner: About 100 elements are shown in the periodic table.

terms.definition: Two or more elements chemically combined in fixed proportions.
terms.examiner: Compounds can only be separated into elements by chemical reactions.

terms.definition: Two or more elements or compounds not chemically combined; each keeps its own properties.
terms.examiner: Separated by filtration, crystallisation, distillation or chromatography.

terms.definition: The number of protons in the nucleus of an atom.
terms.examiner: All atoms of an element have the same number of protons.

terms.definition: The total number of protons and neutrons in an atom.
Atoms of the same element with the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons.
terms.examiner: Relative atomic mass is the mean mass of an element's isotopes, weighted by abundance.

terms.definition: The arrangement of electrons in shells, such as 2,8,1 for sodium.
terms.examiner: Shells hold 2, 8, 8 for the first 20 elements.

terms.definition: A ball of positive charge with negative electrons embedded in it; replaced after the alpha particle scattering experiment.
terms.examiner: Scattering showed the mass is concentrated in a small positive nucleus.
